introduction_text:
Supplier Registration

Okavango Foods Limited invites farmers, individuals, businesses, cooperatives and service providers interested in supplying goods or services to complete this registration.

You do not need to own a registered business to apply.

Please provide correct contact and payment information. You may choose either a bank account or mobile money as your preferred payment method.

Registration does not guarantee appointment as a supplier, award of business, purchase orders or any minimum purchase volume. Applications are subject to internal review and verification.
name: supplier-registration
success_message:
Thank you. Your supplier registration has been received by Okavango Foods Limited.

Your application will be reviewed by Procurement and Finance where applicable.

We may contact you if further information or verification is required.

Registration does not guarantee appointment as a supplier or award of business.

Please do not make any payment to any employee or representative in connection with supplier registration.
